# dsh-chatmode - A web-like minimalist experience
English | 中文
A DeepSeek Harness extension that adds a new **Chat mode**.
> **Author's note:** This project was developed entirely by DeepSeek Harness AI, and the code is ful
ly AI-generated. If you find a bug, please report it.
> Your Skills are preserved, but the model won't perform any actions, and a single thinking pass pro
duces the answer. This gives a web-chat-like experience and saves a lot of tokens.
## What this mode does
- **No tools at all**: the mode mounts no tool plugins (read / write / bash / pwsh / web / todo / su
bagent / goal / plan — none of them), and it hides host-globally-mounted tools within the mode's sco

pe. The tool schema list the model receives is empty.
- **The loop naturally converges to a single p
ass**: no tools means no tool-call turns, so DSH's agent loop ends the turn right after the model's
first reply (one thinking pass, a single answer). It won't continue for multiple steps just to perfo

rm actions.
- **Skills are still kept**:
- Each session receives a one-time skill catalog message (s
kill name + description, for skills within the model's callable scope) telling the model it cannot l

oad skills by itself.
- When the user writes `/skill-name` in the input, that skill's full `<skill_c
ontent>` body is injected automatically in the same step, and the model answers directly according t

o the skill instructions — no `skill` tool needed, and no second generation pass.
- **Lean prompt**:
`persona` uses `complete: true` and `includeRuntimeContext: false`, so the system prompt keeps only
the chat-mode persona and drops sections such as the coding agent, plan mode, and tool guidance, sa
ving even more tokens.
## Installation
[代码示例省略，未执行]
You can also install this directory with `plugin_manager` in any DSH profile (in addition to `cordis
.patch.yml`); the bundle patch inserts the mode declaration automatically.
Once installed, "聊天模式" (Chat mode) appears in **Settings → Modes** (or in the mode selector of a new
session). Select it for a new session, or switch an empty session to it.
## Mode definition
`cordis.patch.yml` inserts one declaration line into `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset`:
| Field | Value |

| `id` | `chatmode` |
| Name | `聊天模式` |
| Description | See above |
| Composition | `@deepseek-ai/ds
h-persona` (chat-mode persona) + `dsh-chatmode` (this package's runtime code) |
This package registers no tools; the runtime code does only two things: publish the skill catalog /
inject `/skill-name` bodies, and hide global tools within the mode's scope.
## Runtime implementation
`index.js` exports a standard Cordis plugin (`name` / `inject` / `apply`):
- `ctx.inject(['tools'])`: listens to `tools/change`, registers the current global tool names as a `
deny` list via `ctx.tools.restrict()`, and refreshes as global tools are added or removed; tools ins

ide the mode scope are always empty.
- `ctx.inject(['skills', 'workingDirectory'])`: listens to `age
nt/pre-step` and, on accepted steps, appends the one-time skill catalog message and the skill body i
njected by `/skill-name`. All failures are swallowed and logged as warnings, so they never turn a co
nversation turn into a failed turn.
It depends on no `@deepseek-ai/*` runtime packages (profile-installed bundles cannot resolve them);
model-visible formats such as message construction and `<skill_content>` rendering are self-containe
d in this package and stay consistent with the official `dsh-tool-skill` / `dsh-skill`.
## Display metadata and language
- Bundle titles and descriptions on the plugin/settings page come from `locale/*.json` and switch wi
th the software language: `locale/en.json` contains only English (`Chat mode` + English description)

, and `locale/zh.json` contains only Chinese (`聊天模式` + Chinese description).
- The name and descript
ion in the mode selector come from the preset declaration in `cordis.patch.yml`, which is a **single
string** returned by the host and does not participate in client-side localization: DSH client's `p
resetDisplayText` only uses localized entries for built-in modes (standard / ptc / minimal / cordis)
, and custom modes display the declared `name`/`description` verbatim (official note: *without makin

g user-authored metadata translatable*).
- Therefore a custom mode cannot achieve "Chinese UI shows
Chinese, English UI shows English". As required, this package sets the mode name/description to **Ch
inese only**: `name: '聊天模式'`, with the Chinese sentence above as the description. To make it English
-only instead, simply change the corresponding text in `cordis.patch.yml` and `package.json`; true p
er-language switching would require a client UI plugin to take over the preset selector, which is co
stly and prone to breaking across versions.
## Verified
After installing into the current desktop profile, the real runtime state was read through a tempora
ry probe inside the host:
- The mode is in the roster: `chatmode` (name, description, order=5), with no `broken` diagnostics.
- The mode composition is mounted and both rows are active: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona` + `dsh-chatmo

de`.
- Within the chat-mode scope the visible tool list is empty (globally mounted Agent Teams tools
are hidden too), the system prompt contains only the chat-mode persona (`complete: true`), and opti
onal runtime context is disabled.
[该节后续省略]
## Limitations
- The model cannot choose skills on its own: it only sees the skill catalog, and the user triggers b
ody injection with `/skill-name`. This is the trade-off under the "zero tools + single-pass generati

on" constraint.
- Existing sessions switched from another mode to this one may still carry old skill
-catalog messages in their history (prompting the model to call the `skill` tool); this mode does no

t rewrite history messages. Starting a new session is recommended to experience chat mode.
- The ski
ll catalog is published only once per session; changes to skill files within a session are not re-se

nt automatically (this mode mounts no compaction/refresh plugins).
- The host must already have the
`skills` service and skill providers mounted (the desktop default composition satisfies this); when
missing, the skill catalog and `/skill-name` injection are skipped automatically and the mode still
ill catalog and `/skill-name` injection are skipped automatically and the mode still chats normally.
